options: Create generic functions that accept encoder/decoder/id_extractor as parameters
Create generic module with type parameters (requires Gleam generics features)
Create code generation tool to generate storage modules
architectural_decisions.rationale: Gleam's type system works well with functions as parameters. More flexible and testable than code generation. Simpler than generic modules.
architectural_decisions.tradeoffs: Callers must pass encoder/decoder/id_extractor to each function call. More verbose but more explicit.
architectural_decisions.reversibility: Yes, can refactor to generic module later if Gleam adds better support

options: Use dependency injection (FileReader, FileWriter as parameters)
architectural_decisions.rationale: Matches existing interview_storage pattern. Makes testing easier with mocks. Follows Functional Core / Imperative Shell principle.
architectural_decisions.tradeoffs: More verbose function signatures. Requires passing functions around.
architectural_decisions.reversibility: Yes, can add convenience wrappers (already planned)

architectural_decisions.decision: Update semantics (filter + append vs in-place update)
options: Filter out old record and append new one (last occurrence wins)
Parse, update in list, re-serialize entire content
Use line numbers to replace specific lines
architectural_decisions.rationale: Matches interview_storage pattern. Simple and predictable. Git-friendly (additions at end). Efficient for append-heavy workloads.
architectural_decisions.tradeoffs: File grows until compaction. Multiple versions of same ID until update. Reading gets last occurrence.
architectural_decisions.reversibility: Yes, can add compaction function later

architectural_decisions.rationale: Matches existing codebase convention. Simple and consistent. String errors are descriptive.
architectural_decisions.tradeoffs: Less type-safe error handling. Can't pattern match on error types.
architectural_decisions.reversibility: Yes, can introduce custom error types later

options: Only JSONL operations (read, write, parse, encode)
architectural_decisions.rationale: Keep module focused on one responsibility. Snapshot/diff are domain-specific to interviews. SQLite sync is separate concern.
architectural_decisions.tradeoffs: Callers must implement snapshot/diff/history if needed. Less code reuse.
architectural_decisions.reversibility: Yes, can extract additional patterns later (WAVE0-02.5?)
